# Count the number of prizes for each beer name within this filtered range
prize_counts = df_filtered['beer name'].value_counts()

# Identify the beer with the maximum number of prizes
max_prizes = prize_counts.max()
most_decorated_beers = prize_counts[prize_counts == max_prizes].index.tolist()

# Check if 'maggs magnificent mild' is among the most decorated beers (and if it is the only one)
answer = 'maggs magnificent mild' in most_decorated_beers and len(most_decorated_beers) == 1
